eligibility.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent
* Participant has successfully completed the parent study and is considered safe to participate by Investigator's clinical judgement.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any medical condition(s) that may put the participant at risk in the investigator's opinion
* Pregnant or nursing (lactating) women
* Women of child-bearing potential, unless they are using effective methods of contraception during dosing and for 16 weeks (= 5 times the terminal half-life) after stopping of study medication

outcomes.description: Evaluate long-term safety and tolerability of pelacarsen (TQJ230) in participants with elevated Lp(a) and established cardiovascular disease who have competed the parent study
outcomes.measure: Incidence of Adverse events (AEs) or serious adverse events (SAEs), including changes in laboratory evaluations, vital signs qualifying and reported as AEs.

outcomes.description: Duration of drug exposure will be collected
Evaluate the long-term effect of pelacarsen on the need for lipoprotein apheresis.
outcomes.measure: Number of lipoprotein apheresis sessions performed yearly for year 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5

outcomes.description: Evaluate the long-term effect of pelacarsen on Lp(a) change.
outcomes.measure: Absolute change in Lp(a) compared to baseline of the parent study.
outcomes.time_frame: month 1, month 3, month 6, month 9, month 12, then every 6 months during OLE (up to 60 months)

outcomes.description: Evaluate the long-term effect of pelacarsen on Lp(a) change.
outcomes.measure: Percentage change in Lp(a) compared to baseline of the parent study.
outcomes.time_frame: month 1, month 3, month 6, month 9, month 12, then every 6 months during OLE (up to 60 months)

trial.brief_summary: This non-randomized, open-label extension study will provide post-trial access to pelacarsen (TQJ230) to participants in Germany with hyperlipoproteinemia(a) and established cardiovascular disease who have successfully completed the double-blind parent study (CTQJ230A12302).
trial.brief_title: An Open Label Extension (OLE) Study to Evaluate Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Pelacarsen (TQJ230)
trial.criteria_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Signed informed consent
* Participant has successfully completed the parent study and is considered safe to participate by Investigator's clinical judgement.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any medical condition(s) that may put the participant at risk in the investigator's opinion
* Pregnant or nursing (lactating) women
* Women of child-bearing potential, unless they are using effective methods of contraception during dosing and for 16 weeks (= 5 times the terminal half-life) after stopping of study medication
trial.detailed_description: This study will allow to evaluate a long-term safety and tolerability of pelacarsen (TQJ230) 80 mg QM in patients. All consenting participants from the parent study who meet the eligibility criteria will be participating in this open label extension study. The maximum duration of this study is approximately 5 years.
trial.official_title: A Single Arm, Open Label Extension (OLE), Multicenter Study to Evaluate Long-term Safety and Tolerability of Pelacarsen (TQJ230) in Patients With Cardiovascular Disease Who Have Successfully Completed the Apheresis Parent Study.
